one_line: Modern B2B customer support platform with a GraphQL API that mirrors the full UI (no API limitations), plus an official MCP server.
auth_notes: GraphQL API at https://core-api.uk.plain.com/graphql/v1, POST-only, Authorization: Bearer <API key>. API keys created in the workspace with scoped permissions (e.g. customer:read).
self_serve_notes: Workspace signup is self-serve with a trial; API keys available to any workspace user. Paid plan required for production use.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Full GraphQL schema covering customers, threads, messages, timelines, and every UI capability; no documented limitations.

existing_mcp.note: Docs explicitly recommend their 'MCP Server' for accessing the GraphQL API from an agent (017_plain.txt).

evidence.note: Fetched text (017_plain.txt) confirms GraphQL API, Bearer API-key auth, and official MCP server.

agent_notes: Free-tier availability uncertain; webhook support inferred from knowledge.
